Find me all datasets in the catalog that are licensed ODC-BY and are suitable for Text Generation, then pick the one that is explicitly English-only and provide its full metadata (ID, name, description, modalities, size, and link). If there are multiple English-only matches, return the largest by stated size.
tasks.reference_answer: {"data": {"id": "PleIAs/common_corpus", "name": "Common Corpus", "description": "Over 2 trillion tokens from diverse sources, filtered for toxicity and curated for ethical standards, used for pretraining models like GPT and BERT.", "tasks": ["Text Generation"], "modalities": [], "languages": ["Multilingual"], "size": "2T tokens", "license": "ODC-BY", "link": "https://huggingface.co/datasets/PleIAs/common_corpus"}}

success_criteria: The final answer identifies at least one dataset returned by list_datasets with license == 'ODC-BY' and tasks including 'Text Generation'.
The selected dataset is explicitly English-only (languages contains 'English' and not 'Multilingual') based on get_dataset metadata.
The response includes the selected dataset’s ID, name, description, modalities, size, license, and link exactly as returned by get_dataset.

tasks.task: I need to draft a compliance note by end of day for a quick internal demo. Please (1) find at least one dataset suitable for Text Generation that is licensed ODC-BY, (2) pull the full metadata for one real eligible dataset (use its exact dataset_id), and (3) choose an Apache 2.0 licensed Sentence Embedding model for retrieval and pull its full metadata. Constraint: the dataset must be ODC-BY and the embedding model must be Apache 2.0.
tasks.reference_answer: {"data": {"id": "sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2", "name": "MiniLM-L6-v2", "description": "Compact English sentence embedding model (384‑dim) distilled from MiniLM, optimized for semantic similarity, clustering and retrieval.", "task": "Sentence Embedding", "license": "Apache 2.0", "link": "https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2"}}

success_criteria: Step 0 returns at least one dataset in $0.data and each returned entry has license == 'ODC-BY'.
Step 1 returns metadata whose data.id equals the dataset_id selected from Step 0 ($0.data.0.id).
Step 2 returns at least one model in $2.data and each returned entry has task == 'Sentence Embedding' and license == 'Apache 2.0'.
Step 3 returns metadata whose data.id equals the model_id selected from Step 2 ($2.data.0.id).

tasks.task: I’m preparing a compliance note today and can only use ODC-BY licensed Text Generation datasets. Find the eligible English dataset that includes BOTH Tabular and Text modalities, then open its full record and confirm its exact license and link for citation.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns at least one dataset with license ODC-BY and task including "Text Generation".
Step 1 returns a dataset record whose id equals the id selected from step 0 (i.e., $0.data.0.id).
From step 1, the dataset license is confirmed as "ODC-BY" and the citation link is present (non-empty).
Step 2 executes successfully using the dataset name from step 1 as the query (regardless of whether it finds matching papers).
